item.title: Major shift: Why students are ditching computer science
item.description:
AI is changing how students pick college majors...
Good morning, and congratulations to Jinny Lu, the winner of the 50th annual World’s Ugliest Dog Contest. In case you need to turn this moment into a LinkedIn post, here’s what the pug with its tongue hanging out of the side of its mouth taught us about perseverance. Jinny Lu’s path to winning the $5,000 prize and eternal bragging rights wasn’t easy: Before being adopted, the pup was abandoned in freezing weather in South Korea. Plus, this was her fourth attempt to clinch the world’s ugliest title, and she finally made it after being first runner-up last year. Take that same energy to prepare for your next sales presentation.

item.title: Dairy Brew: Raw milk rebels and sixty dollar butter
item.description:
A splash of milk culture...
Good morning. Got milk? Because we sure do. Welcome to Dairy Brew, a special edition all about the business of the stuff that Joey from Friends claims he can drink a gallon of in 10 seconds . We’ll explain why some Americans swear by raw milk despite the health risks, discuss whether soy, coconut, and other plant-based “milks” really count as milk, look into why celebs are lathering dairy products all over their bodies, and a lot more.
